 Wp(C) No.32372/2024 3/5 Order Date : 
 Ziyad Rahman A.A., J.
 ---------------------
 W.P.C Nos.32372 and 32224 of 2024
 ---------------------------
 Dated this the 28th day of February, 2025
 Order
Today when the matter came up for consideration, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners
in W.P.(C) No.32372/2024 brought the attention of this Court to the report submitted by the
Pollution
Control Board in W.P.(C)No. 32224/2024.

2. On going through the same it is seen that, several notices were issued to the petitioner in W.P.(C)No.32224/2024, with regard to the inadequacy in the pollution control measures,
particularly in respect of the Effluent Treatment Plant installed by the petitioner.
However, despite the passage of several months, effective steps are not seen taken.
Even though several proposals were submitted, the Pollution Control Board found that, the said proposals were not sufficient to meet the requirements in the hotel.
It is also an undisputed fact that the petitioner could not obtain consent to operate from the Pollution Control Board as well.

The application submitted by the petitioner in this regard is already returned to the petitioner by the Pollution Control Board WP(C) No.32372/2024 4/5 Order Date : 28-02-2025 W.P.C Nos.32372 and 32224 of 2024 citing certain defects.

3. In such circumstances, there shall be an interim order directing the the Pollution Control Board,
to initiate further proceedings against the petitioner for functioning without any valid consent, in case the petitioner in W.P.(C)No.32224/2024 is not coming up with a satisfactory proposal within a period of ten days.
